[RCTS.1.2.15] **`malformed_fixture`: a vector the harness must refuse.**
A fixture whose `expect.kind` is `malformed_fixture` carries one more field,
`expect.reason`: the id of the clause of this document under which the fixture
is malformed, as a string (for example `"RCTS.1.2.14"`). Its subject is the
harness, not a runtime: it pins that a harness refuses what the format makes
malformed.

A harness must check every fixture against the format before it compiles the
program or drives a runtime, and must name, in each such refusal, the clause
the fixture breaks. It passes a `malformed_fixture` fixture only when it
refuses it under the clause `expect.reason` names. It must fail the fixture if
it accepts it, or if it refuses it under any other clause. It drives no runtime
for it.
